units.source_text: 依在扶几上的名人情不自禁地“唔”了一声，

en.t: Leaning on the armrest, the Master could not help letting out a soft “hm,”

units.source_text: 便端正坐姿，拉长下巴颏，张开上眼睑，通观全局似的凝视着棋盘。

en.t: then straightened his posture, thrust out his chin, lifted his upper eyelids, and stared at the board as though taking in the whole position.

units.source_text: 名人眼睑厚，眼角深，双眼发出清澈的光。

en.t: The Master had thick eyelids and deep-set corners to his eyes, and both eyes shone with a clear light.
